title: Waring's band and roommate Hack Gibson
summary: Traveling bands like Mason-Dixon and Fred Waring's played the college, with his roommate Hack Gibson booking for them.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So but that's all we did, but we came along and I think we had a pretty good band. Now, we got chances to listen to maybe the Mason Dixon orchestra which was a traveling band, The Waring Banjo Orchestra. Fred Waring.

Well Tom had it then. Fred was still at school while I was there. He was at Penn State which was 60 miles away. But he used to come down. My roommate was their booker, used to write the letters for them to get the jobs, which he did a little bit for us, having the advantage there.

A fellow by the name of Hack Gibson, Francis Gibson. I think his father put a little money in the band or helped him out someway, but anyway Fred would come down and he would come down with a banjo with one of those soft picks and he -- everybody played a banjo in those days, you know, it was all ukelele fingering.
